answer: Here is a specific defense: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Clustering on shared timing signatures exposes the operator. Because it works by forcing the attacker to duplicate sunk work across every clone, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The network ties the shale to sunk effort, uses the oasis as an corroborating signal, then requires a raven before any payout.
